recorded_by: the synthesis lane, from five read-only reports of 2026-10-02 (the rail, the projection tools, the shelf and gate, R2 and the shipments, the guards); every value names where it was read
what_this_is: the toggle push queue: every delivery of Moses's this lane knows about, what it feeds on the rail, where it sits on R2, which tool projects it, what it waits on, and where the owner's ruling is owed. Read by tools/push-toggles-v1.mjs, which proposes and prints and never chooses. The runbook is TOGGLE-PUSH-PLAN-2026-10-02.md in the reader directory.
why_typed_in_the_open: a delivery's prefix on R2 and its shape are written nowhere this tree can read as data: they sit in comments and prose (tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md, the projectors' headers, the source.ledger strings on receipts), and a candidate with no receipt yet is named nowhere else. So these facts are typed here, each with its source, and 'unknown' is written where the sources name nothing. Anything a receipt can say — which zones carry a layer, what a receipt's rulings_owed says, a source's sha256 — the driver reads off the receipt and never from here.

fields.id: the queue's name for the delivery; also the folder under build/ledgers/ that --fetch writes
fields.feeds: rail row ids from zone.html's TOGGLES registry (order, masorah, sources, pairs, lookup, maqaf, licence, names, edition); a position inside a row is written row/position (order/witnessed_entry, masorah/only); empty when the delivery reaches the card and not the rail, with feeds_note saying where
fields.r2_prefix: the key prefix inside the bucket, as the sources write it after r2:<bucket>/; 'unknown' when no source names one
fields.delivery_shape: per-position ledger / per-card / sidecar / stream, as the sources say, with the file names
fields.objects: the object names the projector reads, with <slug> where there is one per book; empty when nothing is fetched
fields.projection_tool: an existing path under tools/, or 'none yet: <what would be needed>'
fields.carried_by: how the driver tells that a zone already carries the layer: kind zone_field (a dotted path into the zone's JSON), sidecar (a suffix beside the zone), sidecar_field (a dotted path into that sidecar), store_file or record (one file for every zone), none
fields.ruling_owed: true or false; ruling_receipt_field names the receipt field that carries it, or says 'none' and where the ruling is stated instead; ruling_what says what is owed
fields.receipt_pins: dotted paths the driver reads off the first zone that has them and prints, so the pin is read, not typed
fields.next: the entry's own commands, in order, with <slug>, <stamp>, <id> placeholders the driver fills; the shared loop below follows them
fields.guards: the checks for this layer, run by hand from the reader directory with python3 -m http.server 8899 serving it for the browser checks
fields.stop: the line where the owner's ruling is owed and the driver stops

loop: fetch: node tools/push-toggles-v1.mjs --fetch <id> — the delivery lands in build/ledgers/<id>/ and is held to its SHA256SUMS, or every object's sha256 is printed for the projector's own pin

project, per zone: the entry's own command; the output goes under build/, never over data/zones/<slug>.bin, except the two tools that are in place by design (bake-witnessed-order-v1, project-piece-gloss-v1)
regloss: node tools/regloss-zone.mjs --zone <the projected zone under build/> --out data/zones/<slug>.bin --stamp <stamp> — the store re-projected over the zone's keys

re-pin: node tools/emit-zone-store-v1.mjs ; node tools/emit-zone-shipment-v1.mjs ; node tools/emit-store-manifest-v1.mjs --store data/route-store — a zone that changed without a new pin is refused by the reader
guards: the entry's checks, from the reader directory, with python3 -m http.server 8899 --directory . serving it for the browser checks
read: emitted_from.toggles.<name>.rulings_owed on one re-projected zone, printed into the report
stop: the TOGGLES entry in zone.html (step 5) and the ruling (step 6) are the owner's; propose the wording, write nothing
never: never patch a join by hand: a verse that does not prove is held whole and counted on the receipt (tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md:20-30)
never re-pin a zone that did not change: the pins are read off the shelf, so a zone not rewritten keeps its pin; and never rewrite a zone for no reason
never touch the Hebrew: no masoretic marking can be removed from the book page (zone.html, the note above MASORAH_KEY); a projection writes beside the word, never in it
never choose a default: the default of every row is the owner's ruling (tools/TOGGLE-PIPELINE-v1.md:124-125); the driver prints positions and chooses none
never mark a row live or record a ruling: a ruling is the owner's, written as a dated record on the receipt's rulings_owed
never write to R2: this lane holds a read token (tools/emit-zone-shipment-v1.mjs:14-16)
never copy a delivery into data/: build/ledgers/ is where it stays
never type what a record can say: this file is the one place a fact is typed in the open, and it says so in its basis
